## Architectural Philosophy
Xenotrix Technologies avoids agency superficialities and generic IT templates. Systems are built according to four core tenets:
1. Business First: Systems must prove commercial utility, increase speed, or reduce operational expense.
2. AI Native: Artificial intelligence is embedded into fundamental data workflows via LLMs, vector search, and agent swarms.
3. Built to Scale: Modular, typed microservice architectures deployed on containerized infrastructure (Docker, Kubernetes, Cloudflare).
4. Long-Term Partnership: Continuous monitoring, telemetry tracking, patch updates, and performance tuning.

## Core Engineering Services
- Enterprise Web Development: React, Next.js, Vite, FastAPI, Django REST Framework, PostgreSQL, Cloudflare Edge.
- Mobile Application Engineering: Flutter, Dart, iOS Swift, Android Kotlin, Firebase, SQLite.
- Artificial Intelligence & ML Integration: PyTorch, OpenAI API, Qdrant, Pinecone, LangChain, LlamaIndex, OCR/Vision AI.
- Business & Workflow Automation: n8n, Node.js, WhatsApp Business API, Webhooks, Stripe API.
- SaaS Platform Development: Multi-tenant tenant isolation, subscription metering, role-based access control (RBAC).
- Data Analytics & BI: ClickHouse, PostgreSQL, Recharts, PostHog, Grafana telemetry.
- Digital Growth & SEO: Technical SEO audits, Lighthouse 90+ speed tuning, Schema.org structured data.

## Commercial Software Suite
- XenoCRM: Multi-tenant business OS unifying sales pipelines, WhatsApp customer messaging, automated invoicing, inventory, and AI pipeline scoring.
- Xenotune: Generative AI soundscape platform utilizing client-side WebAudio procedural synthesis for deep focus and circadian synchronization.
- XenoBiz: Mobile-first business operating system for small businesses, shops, and wholesalers combining billing, inventory, payments, customer CRM, and WhatsApp messaging.
